For the past month I have been getting an absolutely unacceptable amount of timeouts. Ontop of that, those timeouts led you to the stuck-in-loading bug as well, which you can only resolve by restarting the game. Honestly I really don't want to restart my game thrice just to look at my avatar or world menu. And to join a friend, only to have to rejoin them again multiple times until the timeouts have stopped. Not only does this occur when opening menus, it also occurs when loading others avatars. Each VRchat session I go through at least 10 disconnects and I am not hyperbolizing.

details: After a recent patch which must have changed the way downloading assets works there are immense lag spikes from what I'm assuming is the menu downloading all map and avatar assets from just the selection menu causing downloads ranging  from 50mbps to 100mbps depending on network speed of course I'm on a 300mbps plan on ethernet and even I get lag from the sudden accumulation of data in a sense causing a Denial of Service Error or something This is affecting streamers and users who had sub 25mbps plans
title: Avatar and World Menus causing massive download lagspike
